providers.name: Exa
providers.role: Primary public discovery for Digital Authority V2 candidate pages
providers.incrementalValue: Discovers destination/CVB/guide candidates; does not replace a backlink index
providers.estimatedCostModel: Usage-based Exa credits/API (existing Dealality Exa account)
providers.estimatedCostPerHotelUsd: Typically low single-digit credits for ≤10 searches; confirm Exa dashboard
providers.note: Already the AVA V2 default path. Additional Exa volume still counts as research spend — bound searches per hotel.

providers.name: Parallel
providers.role: Supplementary deep research for hard hotel-specific questions / multilingual gaps Exa missed
providers.incrementalValue: Broader research synthesis when Exa recall is thin; not a backlink database
providers.estimatedCostModel: Task list prices in-repo: lite $0.005, base $0.01, core $0.025, pro $0.10 per task (verify Parallel dashboard)
providers.estimatedCostPerHotelUsd: Pilot envelope: 2–4 core tasks ≈ $0.05–$0.10 + FindAll preview/base if used
providers.note: Client exists under hotel-intelligence / GDI. Do not enable as AVA default.

providers.name: Context.dev
providers.role: JS-heavy scrape, structured extract, brand retrieve for bot-protected or incomplete HTML
providers.incrementalValue: May recover facts from WAF/JS pages and extract structured hotel attributes for DCR
providers.estimatedCostPerHotelUsd: Pilot envelope: ~15–40 credits/hotel (search+scrape+optional extract) — convert via Context.dev plan rate
providers.note: Best for ACCESS_RESTRICTED brand pages and schema/fact extraction — not for backlink graphs.

providers.name: Ahrefs
providers.role: Referring-domain / URL backlink index for verified property backlinks + competitor gaps
providers.endpointsAvailable: Not integrated in this repo (no Ahrefs client or API token in env)
providers.incrementalValue: Highest incremental value for complete backlink inventories Ahrefs/Semrush-class indexes provide
providers.estimatedCostModel: Public Lite ~$129/mo class + API units (max(50, rows×per-row)); confirm current plan
providers.estimatedCostPerHotelUsd: Pilot 3 hotels: expect tens–hundreds of API units depending on referring-domain depth — quote before buy
providers.note: Listed in AVA paid-provider allowlist but **no API key and no client**. Account entitlement must be confirmed outside this repo before any call.

providers.name: DataForSEO
providers.role: Optional pay-as-you-go backlinks + maps/SERP for listing URL discovery
providers.estimatedCostModel: Pay-as-you-go; backlinks ~$0.02+/task class — verify live price list
providers.estimatedCostPerHotelUsd: Pilot 3 hotels: set hard cap e.g. $15–25 total before run
providers.note: Credentials exist for census paths; AVA paid research flag still required. Not a substitute for Ahrefs quality without validation.

defaultPipeline.digitalContentReadiness: identity graph + zero-cost HTTP platform probes

doNotUse: Semrush / Majestic / Moz — no entitlement confirmed for AVA; do not subscribe
Any provider call that bypasses AVA_PAID_RESEARCH_AUTHORIZED for paid backlink indexes
